newsitem.title: CHILE: Foreign investment in Chile up sharply in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Foreign investment in Chile up sharply in 1996.

text.p: Total new foreign investment in Chile rose 42 percent over 1995 last year to $6.17 billion, Economy Minister Alvaro Garcia said.

The figures included $4.57 billion invested through Decree- Law 600, which applies to productive investments including those in the mining sector, and $1.15 billion invested through American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
A total of $445 million were invested through the Central Bank provisions applying mainly to financial investments, said Garcia.
The figures were compiled by the government's Foreign Investment Committee.
